findings.title: Unconditional Exception Handler in Supervisor Research Delegation
findings.impact: Any minor exception (such as a temporary network hiccup or tool failure) during parallel execution of ConductResearch will immediately terminate the entire research phase instead of retrying or handling the specific failure gracefully.
findings.preconditions: An exception is raised during asyncio.gather when executing research tasks in supervisor_tools.
findings.explanation: The condition `if is_token_limit_exceeded(e, configurable.research_model) or True:` evaluates to True unconditionally, meaning any exception caught in the try-except block forces the supervisor to terminate the research prematurely by going to END.
findings.suggestion: Remove the redundant 'or True' check so that exceptions are properly checked against token limits or handled appropriately.
